beats.text: This monolithic retrieval bottleneck happens because standard models treat every paragraph as an isolated island, losing the forest for the trees.

beats.text: RAPTOR pivots by recursively clustering these fragments, effectively weaving disparate sentence leaves into a unified, multi-tiered abstraction tree.
